jobs.titleRaw: Senior Cloud Solution Architecture - Data Security
jobs.aboutTheJobRaw:
Step into a role where your ideas spark innovation and your impact is felt every day. As a Data Security Cloud Solution Architect in the Customer Success Unit, you help customers across Europe North strengthen trust in their data by designing and implementing secure cloud solutions. You work at the forefront of data security in an artificial intelligence–driven world, partnering with technical and business stakeholders to solve complex security challenges and unlock safe cloud adoption at scale.

In this role, you lead security adoption motions across seven subsidiaries, providing deep technical cybersecurity expertise on Microsoft cloud data security capabilities. You guide customers through the design and implementation of secure architectures, help them modernize and protect critical data estates, and ensure that security and compliance are embedded in every stage of their cloud journey. You drive reusable best practices and patterns that improve the scalable security posture of the Europe North area and serve as a role model for other security-focused architects and engineers.

At Microsoft, our mission to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more guides how we partner with customers to deliver trusted, impactful solutions. With a growth‑mindset culture, we innovate responsibly and measure success by shared progress, people, teams, and customers. Join us to do meaningful work that changes the world and helps shape what’s next for everyone.
jobs.responsibilitiesRaw:
• Anticipate, identify, and translate complex customer or partner data security challenges into industry solutions that align with Microsoft cloud platform strategy, helping customers accelerate secure adoption and usage of Microsoft security and data protection capabilities.
  • Guide and mentor virtual teams and technical communities across the Customer Success Unit by role modeling technical readiness in security, resilience, and artificial intelligence–aligned scenarios, and leading upskilling activities that raise overall capability in data security architecture.
  • Proactively act as the voice of the customer, aggregating feedback and patterns across customers and industries, and presenting business cases and insights that influence product roadmaps, security features, and prioritization of fixes to improve customer outcomes.
  • Orchestrate and collaborate across Microsoft and customer teams to deliver secure, resilient, and cost‑optimized architectures, proactively identifying and mitigating technical and business risks to ensure successful deployment and long‑term adoption of data security solutions.
  • Lead strategic partner and customer opportunities in the data security space, leveraging market insights and industry trends to shape security offerings, drive consumption and usage growth, and position Microsoft solutions as trusted, innovative security platforms across Europe North.

jobs.aboutTheJobRaw:
With more than 45,000 employees and partners worldwide, the Customer Experience and Success (CE and S) organization is on a mission to empower customers to accelerate business value through differentiated customer experiences that leverage Microsoft products and services, ignited by our people and culture. CE and S is responsible for all up services across the company, including consulting, customer success, and support across Microsoft's portfolio of solutions and products. Join CE and S and help us accelerate AI transformation for our customers and the world. 

We are looking for a Senior Cloud Solution Architect (CSA), specializing in AI solutions, who is passionate about driving our customers' AI transformation journey with Copilot Chat, Agents, and M365 Copilot. This is a senior, customer-facing role that serves as a strategic trusted advisor and technical subject matter expert to executive and technical decision makers, accelerating AI adoption and change management by creating business value and ROI. As a senior member of the team you will own the most complex and strategically significant customer engagements in Poland, set the technical direction across multiple accounts, and raise the capability of the wider architect community through mentoring, coaching, and reusable intellectual property. 

Part of this portfolio covers customers in the public sector, defence, and critical infrastructure. For that reason the position additionally requires Polish citizenship and an active or obtainable Polish personal security clearance. This opportunity will allow you to work on Poland's most demanding AI transformation programs, deepen your architectural and business value expertise, and grow as a technical leader and mentor. This role is flexible in that you can work up to 50% from home. 

Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
jobs.responsibilitiesRaw:
• Drive customer success. Lead architectural design, engaging with business and technical decision makers to drive intent and enable sustained usage of Copilot Chat, Agents, and M365 Copilot, securing long-term customer success and renewal in the most complex accounts of the subsidiary. 

    Leverage agentic AI. Use Copilot prompt engineering and agent-building expertise to drive AI at scale, and define reference architectures and delivery patterns that other architects reuse. 

    Lead technically across the account team. Orchestrate virtual teams of specialists, resolve escalated technical blockers, and take architectural accountability for engagements carrying significant business, security, or regulatory risk, including work performed under national security clearance. 

    Explore growth opportunities. Partner with technical and sales teams to identify opportunities and develop tailored solutions that drive expansion and business value realization. 

    Grow the community. Mentor and coach less experienced architects, lead readiness and skilling sessions, contribute to intellectual property creation, and prioritize intellectual property re-use to accelerate the AI transformation journey of your customers. 

    Embrace a growth mindset and stay a learn-it-all. Act as the voice of the customer by proactively sharing insights, feedback, and success stories to inform internal strategy and execution, and maintain technical readiness aligned to Customer Success Unit priorities and corporate initiatives.

jobs.aboutTheJobRaw:
As a Microsoft Logistics Technician, you will perform cycle audits, execute incoming/outgoing deliveries, coordinate security escorts for third-party vendors, and document inbound and outbound deliveries as instructed by management.  You will initiate warranty claims and process returns on failed equipment. This opportunity will allow you to build working knowledge of inventory management principles, warranty process management, data bearing device destruction, and advance your career in the process.

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I Logistics Technician, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications.

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 Data Centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

jobs.titleRaw: Critical Environment Technician (CET) - Technik Infrastruktury Krytycznej
jobs.aboutTheJobRaw:
Opis stanowiska

Jako Critical Environment Technician (CET) w zespole Microsoft Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) będziesz wspierać utrzymanie infrastruktury krytycznej, która zapewnia nieprzerwane funkcjonowanie naszych centrów danych.
Do Twoich zadań może należeć m.in. podstawowe monitorowanie i kontrola infrastruktury, wykonywanie różnych rodzajów prac konserwacyjnych, udział w diagnozowaniu i usuwaniu usterek urządzeń, przestrzeganie oraz egzekwowanie wymogów dotyczących bezpieczeństwa i ochrony, a także opracowywanie metod wykonywania prac (MOP – Methods of Procedure) oraz standardowych procedur operacyjnych (SOP – Standard Operating Procedures).
Microsoft Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) stanowi podstawę infrastruktury obsługującej nasze usługi chmurowe. Jako CO+I Critical Environment Technician będziesz odgrywać ważną rolę w zapewnianiu podstawowej infrastruktury i technologii niezbędnych do działania usług online Microsoft, takich jak Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive oraz platforma Microsoft Azure.
CO+I wspiera rozwój osobisty i zawodowy pracowników, oferując szkolenia oraz możliwości rozwoju, w tym programy rotacji zawodowej, szkolenia i wydarzenia związane z różnorodnością i inkluzywnością oraz możliwość zdobywania certyfikatów zawodowych.
Nasza infrastruktura obejmuje rozbudowaną globalną sieć ponad 200 centrów danych w 32 krajach oraz miliony serwerów. Jest ona zarządzana przez zespół ekspertów wspierających usługi dla ponad 1 miliarda klientów i 20 milionów firm w ponad 90 krajach na całym świecie.
 
English version

As a Critical Environment Technician (CET) in Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) team, you will help to maintain the critical infrastructure that keeps our datacenters up and running. This could be anything from performing basic monitoring and inspection, performing various types of maintenance, participating in equipment troubleshooting, enforcing all safety and security requirements, and developing methods of operating procedures (MOPs) and standard operating procedures (SOPs).

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I Critical Environment Technician, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications.

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 datacenters in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.
jobs.responsibilitiesRaw:
Zakres obowiązków

  • Wykonywanie przydzielonych podstawowych zadań, takich jak obchody obiektu, rejestrowanie obserwacji dotyczących budynku oraz wykonywanie pomiarów, przy różnym poziomie nadzoru.
  • Podstawowe monitorowanie i kontrolowanie urządzeń związanych z infrastrukturą krytyczną, takich jak systemy sterowania, ogrzewania, wentylacji i klimatyzacji (HVAC) oraz systemy mechaniczne, a także budynków i terenów zewnętrznych pod kątem niebezpiecznych lub nietypowych warunków.
  • Nauka bezpiecznej i profesjonalnej obsługi wszystkich systemów i urządzeń oraz poznawanie zagrożeń związanych z ich użytkowaniem.
  • Korzystanie z wewnętrznego komputerowego systemu zarządzania utrzymaniem ruchu (CMMS) w celu rejestrowania urządzeń oraz realizacji zleceń dotyczących prac konserwacyjnych.
  • Bezpieczne wspieranie monitorowania sytuacji awaryjnych i reagowania na różnego rodzaju nieprawidłowości, pod nadzorem i zgodnie z procedurami awaryjnymi (EOP – Emergency Operating Procedures).
  • Wykonywanie różnych rodzajów prac konserwacyjnych, w tym konserwacji planowej, predykcyjnej i naprawczej, zgodnie z przydzielonymi zadaniami, metodami wykonywania prac (MOP) oraz standardowymi procedurami operacyjnymi (SOP), w razie potrzeby pod nadzorem.
  • Dokumentowanie wykonanych zadań oraz problemów wykrytych podczas konserwacji i diagnozowania usterek, zapewnianie odpowiednich działań następczych oraz eskalowanie problemów w razie potrzeby.
  • Zapewnianie wymaganej asysty na terenie obiektu zewnętrznym wykonawcom, podwykonawcom, dostawcom oraz usługodawcom zgodnie z odpowiednimi procedurami i poziomem ryzyka.
  • Znajomość, przestrzeganie i egzekwowanie wymogów dotyczących bezpieczeństwa i ochrony, w tym ocen zagrożeń związanych z wykonywaną pracą (JHA – Job Hazard Assessments), zasad ochrony środowiska, bezpieczeństwa i higieny pracy (EH&S) oraz odpraw bezpieczeństwa (toolbox talks).
  • Przestrzeganie procesów i procedur biznesowych w celu zapewnienia bezpiecznego, wysokiej jakości i niezawodnego wykonywania pracy zgodnie z obowiązującymi wymogami prawa oraz standardami Microsoft.
  • Postępowanie zgodnie z kulturą i wartościami Microsoft.

English version

Responsibilities:

  • Perform assigned basic tasks (e.g., making rounds, recording building observations, taking measurements) with varying levels of supervision.
  • Under varying levels of supervision, you will perform basic monitoring and inspection of critical environment-related facility equipment (e.g., controls, heating, ventilation, and air conditioning [HVAC], mechanical systems), building, and grounds for unsafe or abnormal conditions.
  • Learn how to operate all systems and equipment in a safe and professional manner and learn about all risks associated with these systems.
  • Utilize internal computerized maintenance management system (CMMS) to track all equipment assets and to complete work order requests for maintenance work.
  • Safely assist in providing emergency monitoring and response to various abnormal conditions with supervision following emergency operating procedures (EOPs).
  • Perform various types of maintenance (e.g., planned, predictive, corrective) as assigned following methods of procedure (MOPs), and standard operating procedures (SOPs) under supervision where needed.
  • Document tasks/issues found in maintenance and troubleshooting for follow up as needed and escalate as appropriate.
  • Provide necessary escorts for third-party contractors, sub-contractors, vendors, and service providers on site based on the appropriate severity-level procedures.
  • Understand, follow, and ensure safety and security requirements (e.g., job hazard assessments [JHAs], environmental health and safety (EH&S), toolbox talks), and business processes and procedures to properly perform work in a safe, quality, and reliable manner in accordance with applicable federal, state, local, and Microsoft requirements.
  • Embody our culture and values
jobs.minimumQualificationsRaw:
• Wymagane kwalifikacje:

    • Wykształcenie średnie lub równoważne.
    • Znajomość języka angielskiego umożliwiająca swobodną komunikację w środowisku pracy.
    • Technicy Critical Environment muszą posiadać odpowiednie świadectwo kwalifikacyjne uprawniające do wykonywania prac związanych z eksploatacją urządzeń, instalacji oraz sieci energetycznych, czyli polskie świadectwo kwalifikacyjne SEP, co najmniej typu „E” (Eksploatacja). SEP oznacza Stowarzyszenie Elektryków Polskich (Association of Polish Electrical Engineers). Uprawnienia SEP wydawane są na okres 5 lat, a ważne świadectwo należy przedstawić podczas procesu rekrutacyjnego. Wytyczne w tym zakresie określa Ustawa z dnia 10 kwietnia 1997 r. – Prawo energetyczne (Dz.U. z 2006 r. Nr 89, poz. 625 z późn. zm.) oraz Rozporządzenie Ministra Gospodarki, Pracy i Polityki Społecznej z dnia 28 kwietnia 2003 r. w sprawie szczegółowych zasad stwierdzania posiadania kwalifikacji przez osoby zajmujące się eksploatacją urządzeń, instalacji i sieci energetycznych (Dz.U. Nr 89, poz. 828).
    • Gotowość do pracy zmianowej, w tym poza standardowymi godzinami pracy, co może obejmować zmiany wieczorne, nocne, weekendy i/lub święta.

    Wymagania dotyczące weryfikacji bezpieczeństwa:

    Na tym stanowisku wymagane jest spełnienie wymogów Microsoft, klientów i/lub odpowiednich instytucji państwowych dotyczących weryfikacji bezpieczeństwa. Wymagania te obejmują między innymi następujące specjalistyczne kontrole bezpieczeństwa:
    • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: osoba zatrudniona na tym stanowisku musi pomyślnie przejść proces weryfikacji Microsoft Cloud przy zatrudnieniu lub przeniesieniu na stanowisko oraz ponownie co dwa lata.

    Preferowane kwalifikacje:

    Choć nie są one wymagane, dodatkowym atutem będą:
    • Wykształcenie średnie lub równoważne ORAZ udokumentowane doświadczenie w usługach technicznych (np. w środowiskach produkcyjnych/montażowych o wysokiej dostępności lub środowiskach infrastruktury krytycznej, takich jak centra danych, rafinerie ropy naftowej i gazu, szpitale lub zakłady farmaceutyczne).
    LUB
    • Wykształcenie techniczne, ukończenie szkoły technicznej/zawodowej, odpowiednie kwalifikacje zawodowe (np. wojskowe lub techniczne) lub wykształcenie wyższe o równoważnym profilu.
    LUB
    • Równoważne doświadczenie zawodowe.

English version

Required Qualifications:

  • High School Diploma, GED, or equivalent.
  • CE Technicians need to provide a qualification certificate to engage in the operation of equipment, installations, and networks working in an operational capacity (Polish SEP-certified electrician's license, at least type “E”. SEP stands for “Stowarzyszenie Elektryków Polskich / Association of Polish Electrical Engineers”). SEP qualifications are issued for 5 years and an active certificate need to be provided during the Recruiting process. Guidelines in this respect are set out in the Act of 10 April 1997. - Energy Law (Journal of Laws of 2006, No. 89, item 625, as amended) and the Regulation of the Minister of Economy, Labour and Social Policy of 28 April 2003 on the detailed rules for ascertaining qualifications of persons involved in the operation of equipment, installations and energy networks (Journal of Laws No. 89, item 828).
  • Ability to work shifts, including shift assignments during non-standard business hours that may include evening, nighttime, weekends, and/or holidays

Background Check Requirements: 

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: 

  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

While not required, we also look for the following Preferred Qualifications:

  • High School Diploma, GED, or equivalent AND demonstrated technical services experience (e.g., high-availability assembly/manufacturing/critical infrastructure environments such as data centers, oil and gas refineries, hospitals, pharmaceutical)
    • OR Associate's Degree or technical trade certification (e.g., military, trade school), or higher-equivalent education
    • OR equivalent experience.

jobs.titleRaw: Member of Technical Staff - Data Research Engineer
jobs.aboutTheJobRaw:
We are seeking a Data Research Engineer to join our AI team, where we are building the next generation of foundation models across different modalities: text, image, video, audio. If you are passionate about exploring, designing, and building high-quality datasets to drive frontier AI models, this role is for you.

At Microsoft AI, data is at the heart of innovation—and in this role, you will collaborate closely with other colleagues to curate, analyse, and evaluate diverse data sources critical to model development. You’ll lead efforts in developing novel data collection strategies, improving dataset quality, understanding data-driven model behaviours, and aligning datasets with ethical and societal values.

This is a cross-disciplinary, high-impact role ideal for engineers who want to push the boundaries of what AI can learn from data.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
jobs.responsibilitiesRaw:
• Create high-quality datasets for training and evaluation; run experiments on new datasets (data ablations) to assess their impact and determine the most effective data
  • Develop and maintain scalable data pipelines for data ingestion, pre-processing, filtering, and annotation
  • Analyse real-world multimodal datasets to assess quality, diversity, relevance, and identify areas for improvement
  • Build tools and workflows for dataset auditing, visualization, and versioning
